topic: Most Olympic gold medals in men's field hockey: India, 8 (1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, 1980), including six consecutive from Amsterdam 1928 to Melbourne 1956 without losing a match; 13 medals in all. Germany has 4 men's golds (incl. West Germany 1972), Pakistan 3, Great Britain 3, Netherlands 2, Australia 1, Argentina 1, Belgium 1. India beat the United States 24–1 at Los Angeles 1932, the largest margin in Olympic hockey; Dhyan Chand ('the Wizard'), who lived in Jhansi, led the 1928–1936 sides. India's last gold was Moscow 1980; bronze at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024.
